name: SkeletonGroup
summary: One switch for many skeletons: they pulse together, and the content shows when loading ends. Native only.

a11y.apg: While loading, the group is hidden from the screen reader; the content arrives as it is.

props.name: children
props.description: The skeletons and what they stand for.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows the skeletons instead of the content.

props.name: isSkeletonOnly
props.description: Hides the whole group when loading ends, for a group made only of skeletons.

props.name: animation
props.description: pulse breathes; none stays still. With reduced motion, it stays still.
